reasoning: This was a Phase I safety study with a primary endpoint of safety and tolerability, which was met. The study achieved its primary objective of demonstrating that pembrolizumab following TACE can be administered safely with manageable adverse events. The 93.3% PFS rate at 12 weeks suggests potential efficacy signals. However, this is a small single-arm study (n=15) focused on safety rather than efficacy, so we cannot fully evaluate the mechanistic causal chain beyond demonstrating the combination is tolerable.
